about: A module's listenSettingsBecome judged against what it describes, by engine-contracts unreadableSettingsBecome and crates/lf schema.rs unreadable_settings_become, word for word. A base the connection is positioned at stands on the path's first hop.

cases.name: a root edge and its key
a path down two edges
a positioned connection starts below its position
an alias short
cases.refusal: 'listenSettingsBecome' gives 1 aliases for a path of 2 edges: give one per edge

cases.name: a hop past the path
cases.refusal: 'listenSettingsBecome' maps 'events' to hop 1, past the last of its 1 edges

cases.name: a comparison on no field
cases.refusal: 'listenSettingsBecome' maps 'events' by 'in' but names no field to compare

cases.name: a type key names no field
a path that starts at no root collection
cases.refusal: 'listenSettingsBecome' starts nowhere: none of Inbox is a root collection (the root collections: Bases, Notifications)

cases.name: an edge its type does not have
cases.refusal: 'listenSettingsBecome' names 'Sheets' after 'Bases', which is no edge off 'Base' (its edges: Tables)

cases.name: what leaving a key out meant, one value or a list
an absent value on a type key
cases.refusal: 'listenSettingsBecome' gives 'payload' an absent value, but a 'type' key compares no field

cases.name: absent values an eq key cannot compare
cases.refusal: 'listenSettingsBecome' gives 'events' 2 absent values, but an 'eq' key compares one

cases.name: an absent value its values do not spell
cases.refusal: 'listenSettingsBecome' gives 'events' the absent value "assign", which its values do not spell

cases.name: lowercase on a key that compares a field
lowercase on a type key
cases.refusal: 'listenSettingsBecome' gives 'kind' 'lowercase: true', but a 'type' key compares no text

cases.name: an event's own mapping is judged as the module's is
cases.refusal: 'listenSettingsBecome' starts nowhere: none of Nowhere is a root collection (the root collections: Bases, Notifications)

cases.name: an event's own mapping onto another root edge
an absentField with no absent value
cases.refusal: 'listenSettingsBecome' gives 'labels' an 'absentField' but no 'absent' value to compare on it

cases.name: a key that also compares another field, and a changed meaning

changed.note: a created row no longer runs it

cases.name: also on a type key
cases.refusal: 'listenSettingsBecome' gives 'payload' 'also' comparisons, but a 'type' key compares no field

cases.name: also beside an absent value
cases.refusal: 'listenSettingsBecome' gives 'key' 'also' comparisons and an absent value, which is compared on one field

cases.name: an also comparison by type
cases.refusal: 'listenSettingsBecome' gives 'key' an 'also' comparison by 'type', which compares no field

cases.name: absent values a neq key cannot compare
cases.refusal: 'listenSettingsBecome' gives 'events' 2 absent values, but a 'neq' key compares one

cases.name: a changed meaning naming a key the mapping does not map
cases.refusal: 'listenSettingsBecome' names 'field' in 'changed', but maps no key 'field'

manifestReads.about: A manifest's listenSettingsBecome as it is read, by WireListenDeclarations and crates/lf externals.rs settings_become, word for word: unknown keys stripped, the parsed value kept, an empty name refused.

cases.name: unknown keys are stripped at both levels
a path of no edges
cases.refusal: listenSettingsBecome.path: expected at least one edge

cases.name: an empty edge name
cases.refusal: listenSettingsBecome.path: expected non-empty edge names

cases.name: an empty alias
cases.refusal: listenSettingsBecome.aliases: expected non-empty aliases

cases.name: an empty paramFrom
cases.refusal: listenSettingsBecome.paramFrom: expected a non-empty string

cases.name: an empty field
cases.refusal: listenSettingsBecome.keys.field: expected a non-empty string

cases.name: what leaving a key out meant is kept
an absent value that is not text
cases.refusal: listenSettingsBecome.keys.absent: expected a text or a list of texts

cases.name: a lowercase that is not true or false
cases.refusal: listenSettingsBecome.keys.lowercase: expected true or false

cases.name: an event's own mapping is kept, read as the module's is; its own byEvent is stripped
an empty name in an event's own mapping
cases.refusal: listenSettingsBecome.path: expected non-empty edge names

cases.name: an empty absentField
cases.refusal: listenSettingsBecome.keys.absentField: expected a non-empty string

cases.name: also comparisons and changed meanings are kept, their unknown keys stripped
an also comparison on an empty field
cases.refusal: listenSettingsBecome.keys.also.field: expected a non-empty string

cases.name: a changed meaning with no note
cases.refusal: listenSettingsBecome.changed.note: expected a non-empty string
